title: BEN'S IDEATION BOARD — design references
provenance: Pinterest board shared by founder Alexei (Ben Gillies' account, bengillies888) for RWF design ideation. Internal reference only.

ideation_board.name: Reps With Friends ideation
ideation_board.captured: Full-board "save page as" by the founder (design/references/Pinterest.html + Pinterest_files/, 2026-09-03). Pinterest declares 39 pins; all 39 captured — complete, not lazy-truncated. One pin is a 10-frame carousel; one image was pinned 3× (37 unique covers).

method: v2: founder saved the secret ideation board page while logged in. Pins parsed from saved DOM (data-test-pin-id + image signatures); covers fetched at 736px from i.pinimg.com (fallback: saved 236px thumbs). Dedupe vs the earlier 22-pin public-board/profile scrape by pin id AND image signature: zero overlap — the boards are disjoint. Merged wall = 37 ideation covers + 22 earlier pins = 59 cards.
